name: link-preview-card
title: Link Preview Card
description: A rich unfurl card for hyperlinking to anything with a UI or an image, like pasting a link into Slack or Notion: a mocked screenshot thumbnail by default, a real `image` (plus an optional `credit`) for an actual photo with a click-through attribution chip, or a `liveUrl` to embed the real destination page itself, scaled down, as a genuinely live thumbnail rather than a static shot. The thumbnail zooms slightly on hover, an external-link icon fades in over the domain, and the card resolves through a real shimmering skeleton first, timed to the iframe's own `onLoad` event when `liveUrl` is used, so the loading state reflects an actual fetch.
